snapshot: src/v6/ vendored upstream production source (core, lib, providers, settings, view, agent-tools, plugin, rpc, tui, data); upstream tests, smoke tests, CI, references, pnpm workflow, bin/index.ts and duplicate sqlite ambient declarations are excluded
versionFieldCaveat: package.upstream.json is an upstream package.json snapshot aligned to the fixed v6 source; its version field (5.0.3) is a stale identifier not in sync with the fixed tag. The tag and commit above are the only authoritative version source. This snapshot does not participate in install.
adaptations: vendored upstream v6 production source is isolated under src/v6/** with upstream-internal relative import paths unchanged; local code enters only through src/v6/plugin.js and src/v6/rpc.js
local plugin id opencode-quota-zh wraps the real upstream v6 QuotaToastPlugin.setup; upstream keeps its own RPC channel (slkiser.opencode-quota)

the local opencode-quota-zh RPC extends the snapshot handler with pricing and sessionUsage methods and emits a pricingChanged event when the price source or selection changes; the snapshot handler calls the upstream QuotaRpc and maps the result to Chinese sidebar cards; failures propagate as RPC errors and credentials never cross the boundary

shared usage and the v6 report run one server-side usage engine (single pass, per-session fork dedup, price guard, stable quota-row identity) so the sidebar and the report agree for the same scope, price snapshot and data point

Chinese sidebar card presentation retained: multi-line cards, 20-cell remaining bar, used%/remaining% dual percentages, Chinese labels with absolute reset times; bar shape, reference line, countdown format, row name/visibility/order and provider order follow v6 settings

runtime build adds no Babel: tsc compiles the non-TUI sources; raw src/v6/tui/**/*.tsx are staged unmodified with a generated .js re-export per module; the local TUI entry src/tui-v2.tsx is copied unmodified
two data snapshots ship (legacy src/data and vendored src/v6/data); the legacy snapshot is slated for later cleanup
dist/ is generated by npm run build:quota-zh:runtime and never hand-edited; root npm run stage:runtime admits production output plus plugin metadata only
removed: upstream tests, smoke tests, CI workflows, references tree, pnpm workflow and bin/index.ts are not vendored
duplicate sqlite ambient declarations from upstream are not vendored; src/ keeps three distinct declarations (better-sqlite3, bun:sqlite, node:sqlite)

the 4.9-era candidate chain and JWT capability detection remain removed; a new local read-only Codex adapter (src/lib/codex-quota-auth.ts) is wired into the v6 OpenAI provider as a separately attributed Codex CLI account, without replacing host credentials

legacy local command wrappers (/pricing_refresh, /quota_announcements) and the standalone /quota_alerts threshold-alert workflow are not carried forward; price refresh moved into the v6 usage page and announcements into the plugin page
